title: EOS PropertyRecord
description: Embedded claim-like value object representing one numeric technical property claim. Catalog meaning and authority are validated outside this structural contract.

propertyId.description: Identifier of a future Property Catalog Entry, not of this embedded PropertyRecord instance.

valueType.description: Discriminator for the single supported numeric value branch.

quantity.description: Scalar property value using the Quantity contract.

valueRange.description: Interval property value using the ValueRange contract.

measurementQuality.description: Optional metrological quality associated with the represented numeric result.

conditions.description: Optional parent-owned conditions. Array order has no authoritative semantic meaning.

verificationStatus.description: Verification state of this technical claim, not lifecycle state of the parent entity.

sourceLinks.description: Required evidence collection. An empty array is structurally valid; context-aware evidence requirements are application and workflow concerns.
